label: Slack: Find User
description: Resolve a person to their Slack identity: by email (bridge a CRM/ticket contact to a Slack user for DMs) or by user id (turn an event's bare U... into a name and profile). Exactly one of the two keys.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Needs users:read; email lookup also needs users:read.email.

outputs.name: name
outputs.description: Display name (falls back to real name).

outputs.name: user
outputs.description: The full user object as Slack returns it.
